# M/S O.C.Shah — Self-Loading Concrete Mixer Rental

> M/S O.C.Shah (fioriforrent.com) is a leading provider of self-loading concrete mixer
> rentals in Gujarat, Rajasthan, and Maharashtra, India. Founded in 2016, the company
> has 9+ years of experience, operates a fleet of 11 machines (KYB and Ajax brands,
> 4.0–4.3 cubic metre drum capacity, diesel engine), has completed 800+ projects,
> and has served 300+ construction clients — including solar power plants, RCC road
> works, canal lining, and residential and commercial developments.
> Services include: rental & delivery, flexible duration plans (daily/weekly/monthly),
> fully insured equipment, 24/7 technical support, and preventive maintenance.
> Contact: +91-9898020677 | +91-9913737777 | ocsfiori@gmail.com
> Address: E-706, Radhe Infinity, Raksha Shakti Circle, Kudasan, Gandhinagar, Gujarat 382426, India
